label: Anchor enters the sea
driver: The iron anchor actually crosses the water surface
prompt: Water-only close recording beside an old wooden sailing boat in a quiet harbour. A heavy object plunges into the seawater out of view: one deep rounded wet PLOOP, a broad splash throwing water outward, churning bubbles and little drips fading naturally into quiet. Soft liquid low end and crisp water detail. One isolated watery event, no crash, breaking timber, explosion, metal, voices or music.

label: Wooden windlass and hemp anchor cable
driver: Anchor cable paying out or being hauled aboard
prompt: Close isolated recording on a wooden sailing ship: slow manual wooden windlass rotating under load, uneven low oak creaks, restrained repetitive wooden pawl knocks, thick hemp anchor cable rubbing and tensioning across wood. Intact timber and rope, steady continuous work at human hauling speed. Seamless loop, no voices, grunts, music, water, metal chain rattling or motors.

label: Anchor release tackle
driver: Anchor released from its bow stowage
prompt: One short close recording on an old wooden sailing ship: a heavy hemp tackle is cast off, rope slips and rubs briskly over an oak rail with a low wooden fitting knock, then quiet. One compact natural mechanical release, no voices, metal chain, engines, music, cannon or water splash.
